Yaskawa and GAZOO deploy MOTOMAN NEXT for GR KART welding and correction

Introduced in September, the newly detailed system combines images, welding sounds and process data.

Yaskawa Electric ↗28 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Operating in production

Yaskawa and GAZOO Racing disclosed on October 28 that AI-powered robot production technology entered the Gamagori GR KART Workshop in September. It welds pipe frames, inspects quality and corrects results. Yaskawa describes actual production use rather than only a proof of concept.

Responding to workpiece conditions

MOTOMAN NEXT combines GPU-based AI and robot control to evaluate assembly conditions, joint gaps and post-weld outcomes. Welding sounds and process data complement images, supporting decisions and corrections previously dependent on experienced welders.

Keep earlier results separate

The project builds on the SFA Process developed in 2024 for racing roll cages. The earlier reduction from two or three weeks to three days belongs to that project, not current GR KART throughput. New cycle times, defect rates and investment costs are not disclosed.
